generatorSets.referenceNumber: Eight (8) Atlantic Detroit Diesel Emergency Generators Model Number 2000 DSEB
generatorSets.fuelSpecification: 40 CFR Section 80.580; ASTM D4057-95; ASTM D5842-95; ASTM D4177-95; ASTM D2622-03; ASTM D4294-03; ASTM D5453-03a; ASTM D6920-03
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: OPERATING RATE: Emergency and Testing/Maintenance only. The emergency generators shall not be operated in conjunction with a voluntary demand-reduction program or any other interruptible power supply arrangement with a utility, other market participant, or system operator (e.g. Delmarva Power, Delaware Electric Cooperative, PJM, etc.).
generatorSets.observationFrequency: Once a quarter the emergency generators shall be observed for the presence or absence of visible emissions for at least five minutes while the equipment is operating. The five minute observation window must start as soon as generator power is stabilized.
generatorSets.extractionNotes: Document refers to individual unit IDs DG-1 through DG-8 (hours listed for each). Condition 3.8 also limits maintenance/readiness testing to 100 hours/year (separate per-unit limit) in addition to the 204 hours/12-month rolling period; 3.1.3 states fuel sulfur shall not exceed 0.05 percent by weight (0.0005) and other sections reference a more stringent 15 ppm regulatory limit and measured tank fuel at 8 ppm. Equipment IDs (DG-1..DG-8) are present in the document but the Process Equipment description lists the eight generators as a group; therefore a single group entry was created and individual DG IDs noted here.
